messages:
mia (AE): Quick heads-up — Clearwater is evaluating swapping their detector from VendorX to Redwood for prod traffic. They want a 2-week POC focusing on API parity (payload schema), prompt/response deltas, error code mapping, and an initial Dedicated pricing ballpark. Can SE + Solutions run this?
devin (SE): I can run the parity tests. Do we have their sample payloads? They sent 40 example calls.
mia (AE): Copying an example they provided: `{"op":"classify","input":"Detect fraud patterns for txn 0xabc"}` — VendorX returns `score`, `labels[]`, and occasionally `explanation_text`. Customers sometimes rely on `explanation_text`.
jen (Solutions): For brittle parsers, we should offer a strict-mode response that pins to the minimal fields. I'd propose acceptance checks: required fields present, explanation capped at 200 chars unless `full_explain=true`.
omar (Platform Eng): For Dedicated sizing they estimated peak 150 rps and 1.5M tokens/day. Ballpark for a 6-month committed plan on 2xA10g-equivalent GPUs + networking ~ $53k/mo. I'll confirm with infra finance.
devin (SE): I'll run a diff harness against VendorX with their 40 samples and a 200-sample fuzz set. Looking for tokenization differences, extra narrative, and JSON ordering changes.
leah (Security): Clearwater's questionnaire demands HSM-backed key control, encryption-at-rest for logs, and proof we don't persist raw payloads for >30 days. Also asks about contract terms for log-forwarding to their SIEM.
neal (Legal): We'll need to scope the log-forwarding addendum and DPA for EU residency. Send me the dataflow so I can start the draft.
deploy-bot: deployed compatibility-proxy v0.2 to staging at 1768125480
omar (Platform Eng): Compat proxy in staging can emulate VendorX field `explanation_text` behavior via config `compat.explain_mode=append|none|truncate`. Staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood.internal/compat
jen (Solutions): Great — let's run two flows: 1) strict (no explanation_text) 2) emulate (append); then compare parsing pass rates for their integration tests.
devin (SE): Running initial 40-sample run now. Will post a short summary.
mia (AE): Pricing ask: committed 6 months, 2.5M tokens/month avg, enterprise audit logs, SAML SSO, and EU data residency. Can we provide a ballpark? Please include any surcharge for log-forwarding/HSM.
omar (Platform Eng): HSM add-on is a one-time setup + monthly fee. I'll estimate in next 24h. For EU residency, Dedicated in eu-west-1 available. SAML SSO supported via our IdP integrations.
leah (Security): Two potential blockers: 1) they require signed attestations for KMS key lifecycle operations — we can provide AWS KMS audit logs but full lifecycle attestation may need contractual language. 2) SIEM forwarding at high volume might need a separate ingestion path.
neal (Legal): I'll draft the contractual language for KMS attestation and an outline for SIEM forwarding SLAs.
mia (AE): Timeline: kickoff today, parity runs by EOD + 48h fuzz, security answers + legal addendum draft in 72h, pricing proposal in 5 business days. Clearwater is targeting a decision end of month.
jen (Solutions): I'll assemble acceptance criteria: 1) payload parity for 90% of examples, 2) error-code mapping table for common 10 errors, 3) latency p50 within 30% of VendorX baseline, 4) token delta <10% for canonical prompts.
devin (SE): Initial summary: 40-sample run — 32/40 fields matched by default. Main deltas: VendorX collapses lists of single labels into string (we return array), and they append a short `explanation_text` 25% of the time. Will share diffs.
mia (AE): Inline ask from the client: can we expose a toggle so parsers expecting strings get `labels` as CSV? That would make migration frictionless.
omar (Platform Eng): We can add a compatibility output hook: `compat.labels=csv` or `compat.labels=string` but need to flag as beta. Will push a staging flag.
deploy-bot: compat-labels-csv flag enabled in staging at 1768125800
devin (SE): Re-running with csv flag on 10 samples — labels serialized as CSV now. Parsing tests look better.
leah (Security): I'll sign off once we provide data retention docs and KMS flow. Need SRE to provide exact retention windows.
omar (Platform Eng): Retention: hosted logs 14 days by default; Dedicated configurable up to 365 days. I'll document defaults and options.
mia (AE): Thanks team. I'll update Clearwater with next steps and keep them apprised of timing. Ping me if anything needs exec escalation. :rocket:
